verdict.rationale: The pack contains no documented power envelope, such as TGP/TDP or power limits, for the RTX 5080. The vendor's only efficiency language is a vague marketing line about "studio-class power and efficiency." The one independent data point (comm-4) found the older 4080 Super has a better performance-per-watt ratio than the 5080, so nothing shows sustained workloads are power-efficient on this part.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, sustained workloads are power-efficient on this part — documented power envelopes with independent performance-per-watt testing
